info.title: TatvaCare Partner API
info.description:
The TatvaCare Partner API lets you send leads to TatvaCare and read them back, with their activities, calls, notes, files, deals, and support tickets.

Send your key in the `Authorization` header on every call: `token <api_key>:<api_secret>`. Test your key on the [Authentication](/partner-validate-key) page.

New here? Start with the [Quickstart](/partner-quickstart). [Errors](/partner-errors) and [Rate limits](/rate-limits) apply to every operation.

tags.name: Leads
tags.description: Leads are the people you send to TatvaCare. See [Leads](/leads) for how leads work.

tags.name: Activities
tags.description: Activities are forms filled in against a lead, one task type each. See [Activities](/activities).

tags.name: Calls
tags.description: Calls are phone calls logged against a lead. See [Calls](/calls).

tags.name: Notes
tags.description: Notes are free text added to a lead. See [Notes](/notes).

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Files are documents attached to a lead, or to one of its activities or notes. See [Files](/files).

tags.name: Deals
tags.description: A deal is the sale the CRM records when a lead converts. See [Deals](/deals).

tags.name: Tickets
tags.description: Tickets are support requests raised with TatvaCare. See [Tickets](/tickets).

tags.name: Ticket comments
tags.description: Ticket comments are messages added to a ticket. See [Ticket comments](/ticket-comments).

tags.name: Async bulk jobs
tags.description: Bulk jobs load thousands of records in the background. See [Async bulk jobs](/async-bulk).

name.description: The lead's unique ID. The CRM creates it, so don't send it on a create.

first_name.description: First name. If it is unknown, `(no name)` is filled in when it is omitted on create.

mobile_no.description: The lead's phone number in E.164 format, such as `+919900000000`. With your product line and group, it identifies the lead. See [Phone format](/conventions#phone-format).

custom_alternate_number.description: Alternate contact phone (optional). E.164, same as `mobile_no`.

status.description: The lead's status. The CRM sets a default on create. If you send it on every sync, you overwrite the status the CRM has moved to. Read the values from `lead_schema`.

source.description: Lead acquisition channel. Read the allowed values from `lead_schema`.

lead_owner.description: Set by the CRM when it assigns the lead. A value you send is ignored.

lost_reason.description: Required when `status` is `Junk` or `Unqualified`. Read the allowed values from `lead_schema`.

lost_notes.description: Free-text note explaining why the lead was lost.

custom_vertical.description: The product line of TatvaCare. Your key sets it, so you don't send it.

custom_group.description: The group within the product line. Your key sets it, so you don't send it.

custom_current_program.description: The lead's current program. Changing it moves the same lead to the new program. The allowed values are in `routing.allowed_programs` from `lead_schema`.

custom_previous_program.description: The lead's previous program if it transitioned. Records the last switch only.

custom_origin_vertical.description: The product line the lead first entered through. Captured once and never updated.

custom_source_origin.description: Where the lead source data originated. Deprecated for new writes; use `source` instead.

custom_patient_id.description: External identifier from the source system.

custom_lsq_prospect_id.description: Legacy migration identifier. Not populated for new leads.

custom_lead_gen_id.description: The ID of the campaign or form submission the lead came from.

custom_patient_age.description: Age in years. Caller-provided; not derived from the date of birth.

custom_caregiver_relation.description: Caregiver's relationship to the lead (for example Spouse, Daughter, Son).

custom_plan_profile.description: Plan details, such as the plan, subscription, program, duration, and payment. One object per row, matched by `custom_plan_assigned_date`. See [Sections](/discover-schema#sections).

custom_lab_profile.description: Lab values, vitals, conditions, and scores. One object per row, matched by `report_date`. See [Sections](/discover-schema#sections).

custom_screening_answers.description: Answers to form questions, as question-and-answer pairs, if your key can use this section. A changed answer is added, and earlier answers are kept. See [Sections](/discover-schema#sections).

custom_care_providers_profile.description: The care team: coach, relationship manager, therapist, doctor, and hospital. One object, merged into the lead's single row. See [Sections](/discover-schema#sections).

custom_acquisition_profile.description: How and when the lead was acquired: campaign, UTM parameters, and funnel dates. One object per row, matched by `touch_at`. See [Sections](/discover-schema#sections).

products.description: The plans bought, with prices. One object per row, matched by `custom_start_date`. Rows sent before the lead converts are copied onto its deal. See [Sections](/discover-schema#sections).

custom_drug_program_profile.description: The drug program, one row per cycle: indication, dosage, prescription, and order. One object per row, matched by `cycle_date`. See [Sections](/discover-schema#sections).

custom_lead_activity_metrics.description: Activity counts and last-activity times for the lead. One object, merged into the lead's single row. See [Sections](/discover-schema#sections).

custom_address_line_1.description: The first line of the person's address.

custom_country.description: Country. Read the allowed values from `lead_schema`.

custom_uhid_mrd.description: The person's hospital record number in the source system.

custom_per_day_opd_size.description: How many people the clinic sees in a day.

custom_clinic_latitude.description: The clinic's latitude, set by the CRM from its address. A value you send is ignored.

custom_clinic_longitude.description: The clinic's longitude, set by the CRM from its address. A value you send is ignored.

data.bytes: Send the bytes as a `file_url` the server downloads, or as `content_base64`. Send exactly one. The largest file the server downloads is 25 MB.
data.screening: Every file is scanned for malware before it is stored. Nothing is saved unless it passes. A file the scan refuses returns 400 with `error.code` `validation_error`, and `error.detail` gives the verdict (`Type Not Allowed`, `Type Mismatch` or `Infected`), the file name and, for an infected file, the signature. If the scanner can't be reached, the file was never checked: the response is 503 with `error.code` `server_busy` and `error.detail.verdict` `Scanner Unavailable`, and the same call is retried with exponential backoff. The scan checks the bytes, so it applies to `content_base64` and `file_url` alike. A refused file is not kept and can't be retrieved; send a clean copy instead.
data.privacy: Every file attached through this API is private, so `is_private` is always true. `file_url` is a signed link that stops working at `expires_at`. Reading the file again by `name` returns a new link.
data.target: A file is attached to its lead by default. Send `activity` with an activity's `name` to attach it to that activity, or `note` with a note's `name` to attach it to that note. The activity or note must belong to the same lead.
data.immutable: A file's bytes can't be changed. To replace a file, attach the new one, then delete the old one.

Without them, the CRM matches the customer's number there: `from_number` on an Inbound call, `to_number` on an Outbound call. If no lead, or more than one, matches, the call is saved without a lead and `lead` reads null. A call is never linked to the wrong lead.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The number of calls your key can make in each window. Sent on every response. A limit across all keys also applies, so a `429` can come even when your own budget isn't used up. See [Rate limits](/rate-limits). Not sent when rate limits don't apply to your key.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: How many calls your key has left. Pace your calls steadily so this never reaches `0`. Not sent when rate limits don't apply to your key.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until your full budget is back. `0` means it's full now. It counts seconds from now; it isn't a timestamp. To retry a refused call, wait for `Retry-After` instead. Not sent when rate limits don't apply to your key.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before you retry. Sent when the API knows the wait: a `429`, or a `503` when the service is at capacity or a bulk write conflicted. It matches `error.retry_after`. When it's missing, such as during a file-scanner outage, back off exponentially. Always wait at least this long.

BadRequest.description: The request isn't valid. `error.code` says why, and `error.fields` names the fields.

Unauthorized.description: The `Authorization` header is malformed, or the key or secret is wrong.

Forbidden.description: The request has no `Authorization` header, or your key can't make this call.

NotFound.description: What you asked for doesn't exist, or your key can't reach it.

DealNotFound.description: The lead doesn't exist, your key can't reach it, or it hasn't converted yet.

Conflict.description: The same `Idempotency-Key` is still being processed, or the record clashes with one that already exists.

DeleteConflict.description: The record has linked records, so it can't be deleted. Or the same `Idempotency-Key` is still being processed.

CancelConflict.description: The job has already finished, so it can't be cancelled. Or the same `Idempotency-Key` is still being processed.

IdempotencyMismatch.description: The `Idempotency-Key` was used before with a different body or endpoint.

RateLimited.description: Your key reached a rate limit. Wait `error.retry_after` seconds, then retry.

ServerError.description: Something went wrong on the TatvaCare side. Retry once with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

ServerBusy.description: The service is busy. Wait `error.retry_after` seconds if it's given, then retry.

BulkBusy.description: The service is busy, or the call collided with other work and nothing was saved. Wait `error.retry_after` seconds, then send the whole call again.

FileBusy.description: The malware scanner or the service is unavailable, or a bulk call collided with other work. Nothing was saved. Retry with a growing wait.

partnerToken.name: Authorization
partnerToken.description: The partner's API key and secret, sent as `token <api_key>:<api_secret>`. Token auth is exempt from CSRF, so no csrf_token is needed. A missing or invalid key returns 401 with the same error envelope as every other failure.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe. The first request with a key runs, and its response is stored. A retry with the same key and body returns that stored response and writes nothing. The same key with a different body returns `422`. Without a key, a retried create makes a second record. `external_id` doesn't make a retry safe.
